paragraphs.text:
A man in his late 30s emerges from the ruin. His weather-
beaten  suit  and  straggly  beard  suggest  several  months  in 
the woods, but his eyes are sharp. He takes a long look at 
Bernard, Sylvia, and Norman. Grinning, he steps up to you 
for a vigorous handshake.

“Dr. Nadelmann, I presume. You did it, Professor. You made it 
here. My name… is Jackson Elias.”
The Nadelmann Expedition is over. THE END.
